title: ASL Alphabet Translator
description: Real-time ASL alphabet translator using CNN and Random Forest models achieving 95%+ accuracy. Built a video inference pipeline with MediaPipe and OpenCV, reducing latency by 40% using TFLite.

title: Loadstone
description: Mobile-first decision-support app combining task planning, wellbeing signals, and AI tools. NestJS backend with Azure Cosmos DB, OIDC authentication via Entra External ID, and Azure OpenAI integration with schema-validated tool-calling.

title: HackDavis Platform
description: Technical platform for UC Davis' largest student-run hackathon (1000+ participants). Built the judging platform, judge-to-team pairing algorithms, event calendar system, and a generative AI chatbot with RAG-based knowledge system.

title: Collaborative Trip Planner
description: Website to allow people to interactively plan trips together. Invite others using unique join codes, create activities, and allow users to vote for desirable activities.

title: Song Genre Classifier
description: Predict a song's genre purely from its audio file using a Random Forest Classifier.

title: Nilay Health
description: Full-stack patient management system for hospitals. Features include patient records, appointment and medication scheduling, automated prescription generation, and Twilio SMS reminders that reduced missed appointments by ~25% for 400+ patients weekly.

title: Donation and Inventory Manager
description: Website facilitating in-person item donations for Davis Community Meals and Housing. Highlights in-demand items to ensure balanced inventory, with admin controls for tracking levels and sending email notifications for high-need items.

title: Speech to Text Converter
description: React Native voice assistant for a stock advice app with local speech-to-text conversion. Integrated on-device speech recognition with pronunciation variants for 150+ companies.

title: Breast Cancer Detection
description: Comparing 10 different ML models to find the best one for classification of breast cancer.
